description: This file defines the 'PageBreak' class, which models a page break in a spreadsheet worksheet, including properties such as break type, coordinate, and maximum column or row, along with getter methods.

classes.name: PageBreak
classes.description: Represents a page break in a worksheet, managing break type, location, and related properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a PageBreak object with specified break type, coordinate, and optional maximum column or row.

methods.name: getBreakType
methods.description: Returns the type of the page break.

methods.name: getCoordinate
methods.description: Returns the cell coordinate associated with the page break.

methods.name: getMaxColOrRow
methods.description: Returns the maximum column or row index related to the break.

methods.name: getColumnInt
methods.description: Returns the column index as an integer from the coordinate.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Returns the row index as an integer from the coordinate.

methods.name: getColumnString
methods.description: Returns the column part of the coordinate as a string.
